audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 and Level 6 rows disagree with the packet chart and with the content layer's own whys. Full/content agree on Level 1 (Neeko) but the packet says Skill and whys[0] says 'Level 1 is even'. Level 6 says Neeko in both layers while whys[4] says 'Her power spike crushes mine'.
audit.why: The page currently tells a player they win the exact level at which the content text says Perfect Execution deletes them.
audit.corrected: Level 1 -> Skill (5/10), Level 6 -> Akali (3/10), proposed as matched full/content pairs. Rest of the chart already matches the packet.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why sold Level 6 as a Neeko setup puzzle and named no Akali ability. Perfect Execution is 120/90/60s, a leap plus a recast dash that executes.
audit.why: Pop Blossom needs a preparation before the knockup; her recast is instant, so the ult race at 6 goes to her unless the root lands first.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rebuilt on Perfect Execution vs the Pop Blossom wind-up; Zhonya's moved up in itemization as the actual answer to it.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] and wants.foe[0] claim Twilight Shroud lets Akali 'break my E root' / 'break your E root channel'. Riot's text says the shroud makes her invisible and unable to be SELECTED by enemy spells and attacks — untargetability is not a cleanse, and Tangle-Barbs is not a channel. Separately, mid and wants.you[2] claim 'W-Shapesplitter invisibility', which is not in Neeko's W description (clone plus recast redirect only).
audit.why: Both errors teach the wrong timing: a root landed before the shroud still holds her, and a player told they have invisibility will walk into a trade with a clone instead.
audit.corrected: report[5].t now states unselectable-not-immune plus the 20s rank-1 cooldown; whys[3], wants.foe[0], wants.you[2] and mid rewritten. Assassin's Mark added to dontsFull[0].d as the real reason extended auto wars lose.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8] says 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain'. Nothing in Akali's kit heals.
audit.why: Grievous Wounds is dead gold in this matchup and displaces the item that actually matters.
audit.corrected: Replaced with a Zhonya's rush framed against Perfect Execution.
sources: enemyKit all slots — no heal flag

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole full layer refers to Akali as 'he/his' while the content layer uses 'she/her'.
audit.why: Same page, two pronouns for the same champion.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in tldr, tradeGood, tradeBad, ahead, breakdown.wave, breakdown.trading and the mirrored report[] entries.

notes: Two dangerous claims removed: Twilight Shroud does NOT break an existing root (Riot's text gives invisibility and unselectability only), and Neeko's Shapesplitter has no invisibility in its description — it sends a clone and recasts to redirect it. Both had propagated into the level-by-level advice. Anti-heal was recommended against a champion with zero healing in her kit; replaced with a Zhonya's rush. Full layer used male pronouns for Akali throughout while the content layer used female; fixed on every prose field that carried it. Level 1 and Level 6 chart rows proposed as matched full/content pairs; the other five rows already agreed with the packet.
